featured_proof.title: Source-linked 90-day readiness handoff
featured_proof.mechanism: Transforms current activities, relationships, a previous schedule snapshot, and QA/document requirements into readiness, schedule-change, and source-linked impact outputs.
featured_proof.verified_receipt: 34 tests passing on the current public PR head; byte-stable regression and recovery path preserved.
featured_proof.boundary: Not yet verified against the engineer's real P6 export or a live project.
featured_proof.next_evidence_event: one anonymized real planning cycle -> engineer ACCEPT / CORRECT / REJECT

featured_proof.title: SignalOps
featured_proof.mechanism: Separates observed market evidence from interpretation, applies deterministic policy, preserves provenance, and renders restartable next-action state.
featured_proof.verified_receipt: 20 real public GitHub surfaces processed: 19 routed to public_reply, 1 to save; private escalation remained policy-gated.
featured_proof.boundary: Does not prove maintainer response, meetings, pipeline, demand, or revenue.

featured_proof.title: DriftGuard
featured_proof.mechanism: A seven-gate settlement preflight for false-idle, lost continuation, stale callbacks, checkpoint corruption, unbounded waits, and session/provider drift.
featured_proof.verified_receipt: A violated blocking gate deterministically forces Block; missing proof cannot become Pass.
featured_proof.boundary: No production-incident reduction or external adoption is claimed without external outcome data.

featured_proof.title: Impact Lens
featured_proof.mechanism: Compiles the same evidence differently for an employer, buyer, collaborator, or practitioner without upgrading proof levels or inventing company-specific evidence.
featured_proof.verified_receipt: Registry-bounded relevance, source/inference/boundary separation, artifact analysis, and deterministic fallback are implemented.
featured_proof.boundary: Conversion lift, repeated use, and generalized relevance quality remain external tests.

renderers.github: mechanism + reproduce path + current receipt + next external test

maintenance_rule: Update the evidence registry or source receipt first. Presentation may reprioritize evidence but must never upgrade its proof state.
